# RandomProjectionDimensionalityReduction

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that uses random linear projections to reduce data dimensionality while approximately preserving pairwise distances or information content. Supports efficient data compression and feature extraction in topology-centric computing, reducing communication and storage overhead in network-centric architectures.
